resume: Contenu original – licence CC BY-SA 4.0. Parler des déplacements et de leurs problèmes, comparer des sources d'énergie et discuter des projets d'aménagement durables.
notions: Mobilité, énergie et environnement : mise en situation
Mobilité, énergie et environnement : adjectifs et adverbes
Mobilité, énergie et environnement : expressions et mots de liaison

sections.contenu:
*Traffic **congestion** is a daily problem in many cities. To reduce **emissions**, our town council plans to extend the **cycle lanes**, improve **public transport** and create a **car-sharing** scheme. A consultant has also compared **renewable energy** sources for the new business park: **solar panels** would be cheaper to install, while **wind turbines** would produce more power but face opposition from local residents.*

Pour comparer : *X is cheaper / more reliable than Y*, *X produces twice as much energy as Y*, *whereas* (alors que).
notions: Mobilité, énergie et environnement : mise en situation

sections.contenu:
| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **to commute** | faire la navette domicile-travail | *Most residents commute by car.* |
| **to reduce** | réduire | *We must reduce our carbon footprint.* |
| **to pollute** | polluer | *Old diesel vans pollute a lot.* |
| **to recycle** | recycler | *We recycle 80% of our waste.* |
| **to save (energy)** | économiser (de l'énergie) | *LED bulbs save energy.* |
| **to run on** | fonctionner à | *The buses run on electricity.* |
| **to car-pool** | faire du covoiturage | *Colleagues car-pool to the office.* |

| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **traffic jam / congestion** | embouteillage / congestion | *I was stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.* |
| **public transport** | les transports en commun | *Public transport is free on Sundays.* |
| **a cycle lane** | une piste cyclable | *The city built ten kilometres of cycle lanes.* |
| **emissions** | les émissions (de gaz) | *Transport accounts for a third of emissions.* |
| **renewable energy** | les énergies renouvelables | *Renewable energy is growing fast.* |
| **a wind turbine / solar panels** | une éolienne / des panneaux solaires | *Solar panels cover the roof.* |
| **the carbon footprint** | l'empreinte carbone | *Video calls reduce our carbon footprint.* |

| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **sustainable** | durable | *We need sustainable solutions.* |
| **eco-friendly** | écologique, respectueux de l'environnement | *They use eco-friendly packaging.* |
| **reliable** | fiable | *Wind power is less reliable than nuclear power.* |
| **crowded** | bondé | *Trains are crowded at rush hour.* |
| **fossil (fuels)** | (combustibles) fossiles | *We still depend on fossil fuels.* |
| **energy-efficient** | économe en énergie | *This building is very energy-efficient.* |
notions: Mobilité, énergie et environnement : adjectifs et adverbes

sections.contenu:
| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **whereas** | alors que (opposition) | *Solar is cheap, whereas nuclear is expensive to build.* |
| **in the long run** | à long terme | *In the long run, it will save money.* |
| **rush hour** | l'heure de pointe | *Avoid driving at rush hour.* |
| **as a result** | par conséquent | *Fuel prices rose; as a result, more people cycled.* |
| **to go green** | devenir plus écologique | *Our company has decided to go green.* |
